attributes.name: SDLC ingest stalled (schedule-aware)

esqlQuery.esql: FROM github-intel-pull-requests | WHERE github.state == "OPEN" | EVAL age_days = DATE_DIFF("days", github.created_at, NOW()) | WHERE age_days > 7 | KEEP entity.number, repository.full_name, age_days | LIMIT 10

attributes.description: Fires when a sync source has not written documents for longer than its own schedule allows. Thresholds are per-source (3h for 30m/1h workflows, 18h for 2h/6h, 30h for 12h/1d) at roughly 2.5x the interval, so one missed run is tolerated and two consecutive misses alert. A flat threshold cannot work here: the catalog workflows run every: 1d, so a 6h rule reported them stalled for 18 hours of every day and buried genuine stalls in permanent noise. Sources owned by workflows that ship disabled (Salesforce, Slack, Drive, SDH) are excluded: a source nobody enabled is not a stall, and alerting on it trains people to ignore the rule.
